El delantero del Baltika Kaliningrad de Rusia anotó su doblete a los 18 minutos cuando definió de derecha ante la salida del portero tras recibir un largo pase de Osorio, quien metió el tercer gol a los 29 con un disparo cruzado dentro del área tras controlar con el pecho un pase de Mauricio Cerritos. En la segunda parte, los dirigidos por el colombiano Hernán Darío "Bolillo" Gómez cedieron la iniciativa a sus rivales, que aprovecharon para descontar al minuto 51 a través de un tiro penal que anotó Janis Antiste. En los minutos restantes del encuentro, Martinica llegó con cierto peligro al área de El Salvador, pero no pudo concretar las opciones que generó. OTROS FRENTES En los otros partidos del Grupo B, Jamaica aprovechó su condición de local en el estadio Nacional de Kingston y sacó un agónico triunfo ante Guatemala por 3-2 gracias a los goles de Kasey Palmer, Rumarn Burrell y Renaldo Cephas a los 37, 53 y 94 minutos, respectivamente. Para la selección guatemalteca anotó Óscar Santis a los dos y 67 minutos. En tanto, en el encuentro disputado en el estadio Nacional Chelato Uclés, en Tegucigalpa, Surinam venció por 3-2 como visitante a Honduras con tantos de Justin Lonwijk, Denzel Jubitana y Luis Palma en su propia portería a los 18, 39 y 66 minutos. Mientras que para Honduras anotaron Dereck Moncada y Bryan Rochez a los 20 y 23 minutos. Al final del partido los aficionados hondureños abuchearon a su selección. "Muy triste porque queríamos los tres puntos y ganar ante nuestra gente, tuvimos desatenciones que pagamos caro, pero faltan tres partidos y vamos con esa mentalidad de ganarlos con mucho trabajo, personalidad, disciplina y confianza. Esto solo lo podemos revertir con trabajo y confianza", dijo Rochez a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf. De esta manera, El Salvador se ubicó como líder del Grupo B con tres puntos, los mismos que registran Surinam y Jamaica, pero una mayor diferencia de goles. Honduras, Guatemala y Martinica se quedaron sin sumar. En la segunda jornada del grupo, que se disputará el lunes, Jamaica será local ante Honduras, El Salvador visitará a Guatemala y Surinam enfrentará a Martinica. El jueves, en actividad del Grupo A, Curazao se sobrepuso tras recibir tres goles y sacó un valioso triunfo por 4-3 como visitante ante Costa Rica. República Dominicana ganó a Nicaragua por 3-2, mismo marcador con el que Haití venció a Trinidad y Tobago. Curazao, Haití y República Dominicana se ubicaron en los tres primeros lugares del sector con tres puntos cada uno. En la segunda jornada del grupo, que se disputará el domingo, Costa Rica visitará a Haití, Curazao será local ante Nicaragua, y Trinidad y Tobago jugará ante República Dominicana. Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos avanzarán a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf. Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027. La Liga de Naciones es una competencia de selecciones nacionales lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro de Concacaf compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas Mundiales. Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

item.title: 中国、米国産石炭を年1000万トン以上輸入へ－ホワイトハウス
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国は2027年に米国産石炭を少なくとも1000万トン輸入し、28年にも同量以上を輸入することに同意した。米中の貿易摩擦緩和に向けたさらなる進展を示している。

ホワイトハウスが25日に公表したファクトシートによると、米国と中国は、新たに始動した米中貿易評議会の下で合意した枠組みの一環として、両国の300億ドル（約4兆7200億円）相当の非機微品目について、優遇関税の適用を目指す。

優遇関税の対象となる米国製品には、農産物や水産物、木材、化粧品、医療機器が含まれる。中国製品では、小型家電や玩具、ホリデー用の装飾品、チャイルドシートなどの消費財が対象となる。

24日にはワシントンでトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席による首脳会談が行われた。米中間では貿易が長く対立点となっており、トランプ氏の2期目に中国は米関税措置の主要な対象国の一つとなっている。

石炭生産はトランプ氏が重視する政策課題の一つ。石炭を米国の主要なエネルギー源として再び位置付けるため、業界の再活性化を進めている。トランプ氏は6月、石炭産業を強化するため、数億ドル規模の公的資金を投入する方針を示していた。

今回の米中合意は、米国内のエネルギー価格が高騰する中でまとまった。新たな工場やAI産業を支えるデータセンター向けの電力需要が急増し、電気料金を押し上げている。

中国国務院新聞弁公室と商務省に26日の通常の業務時間外に電話でコメントを求めたが、応答はなかった。

ホワイトハウスによると、米中両国は農業分野の市場参入障壁への対応を協議する作業部会を立ち上げた。農業は長年、米中の通商交渉で主要な争点の一つとなってきた。

米中は「投資評議会」も設置。同評議会は、投資の機会やそれを妨げる要因について協議する場となる。両国はさらに、レアアースやその他の重要鉱物のサプライチェーンを巡る米国側の懸念への対応を続けることでも一致した。

item.title: Six big takeaways from a turbulent week of UN diplomacy
item.description: Limousines whisked world leaders away from the United Nations on Friday after a week of speeches, meetings and hallway diplomacy.
item.dc:creator: Antoni Slodkowski
item.content:encoded: Limousines whisked world leaders away from the United Nations on Friday after a week of speeches, meetings and hallway diplomacy. While they reached no breakthroughs on the world's most intractable conflicts, talks on the Iran and Ukraine wars inched forward and global powers used the venue to debate AI risks with industry leaders. Here are the big takeaways from scores of panels, hundreds of meetings, hours spent in lines and listening to speeches – and countless cups of coffee: REBOOT OF IRAN DIPLOMACY The UN was probably most useful for facilitating the [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"first shuttle talks"] between American and Iranian officials since the collapse of a ceasefire in July. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators. The efforts must continue, a senior Iranian official told Reuters, even as Iranian and American leaders exchanged sharp words at the General Assembly hall, with the US threatening to "annihilate" Iran and Iran accusing the US of a "bullying mentality." The senior Iranian official said Tehran was reviewing Washington's response to its proposals, which include lifting a US naval blockade on Iranian ports and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. But no agreement appeared imminent. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cautioned that a deal would involve hard work over time. UKRAINE GRAIN AND ENERGY Rubio also held talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, after which he said Ukraine and Russia had both [USN:L1N45F0K5 TEXT:"voiced an interest"] in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy-related targets. Ukraine and its allies are racing to secure limited agreements on energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping before winter, fearing renewed Russian strikes on power and heating facilities. But hours after Rubio spoke on Wednesday, Lavrov addressed the Security Council meeting on Ukraine, showing no indication Russia was prepared to engage on any subject. "Europe, whatever it thinks, just wants to get a pause, and it wants to use it to pump the Kyiv regime with weapons," Lavrov said. AI STEALS CLIMATE'S SPOTLIGHT Climate change — a focus of UN discussions in recent years — was largely pushed aside by debate over artificial intelligence. The festival of diplomacy coincided with an unprecedented outpouring of concern around AI after several safety breaches, and as top researchers warned it could destroy humanity. The UN convened a Security Council meeting featuring OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, who made an appearance in person, as well as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. The industry leaders [USN:L6N45E0VV TEXT:"appealed"] for governments to work together to manage AI. Underscoring the concerns, just as they spoke, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said that an AI agent developed by OpenAI infiltrated an Australian government website in June, accessing public and non-public files. US President Donald Trump, who has dismissed AI risks as a "hoax" and "sick conspiracy," told the UN he "rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control" AI, describing it as amazing while promising the US would be careful. SURPRISE ARRIVAL The biggest surprise arrival at the UN was Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez, who used her trip to hold [USN:L6N45E138 TEXT:"first in-person talks with Trump"] since coming to power after US forces grabbed then-President Nicolas Maduro in a dramatic nighttime raid. The Venezuelan delegation's focus was on restructuring its billions of dollars in sovereign debt as it met US officials, multilateral lenders and companies. Trump used his speech to the body dedicated to global peace to declare that in Venezuela: "to the victor belong the spoils," and called an oil deal the US signed with Caracas last month "perhaps the biggest deal ever made." As Rodriguez and Trump met in New York, Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado [USN:L1N45F02O TEXT:"made three unsuccessful bids"] to return to her country. SURPRISE ABSENCE The biggest surprise absence was the Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. The US [USN:L6N45F185 TEXT:"withheld his visa"] in a move that Sudanese and other sources said was linked to a US-backed ceasefire proposal that Khartoum has resisted. The dispute, first reported by Reuters, threatened to deepen tensions between Washington and Sudan's army at a critical moment in the civil war, which the UN calls the world's largest humanitarian crisis. Burhan had represented Sudan at the General Assembly since the coup. Another notable absentee was Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, who addressed delegates by video and [USN:L8N45G1M5 TEXT:"condemned US curbs"] on the Palestinian mission's access to the UN. UNCERTAIN FUTURE The cash-strapped United Nations may no longer be in "freefall," but it remains stuck in an [USN:L4N45906F TEXT:""open-ended crisis"]," International Crisis Group analyst Richard Gowan said. The organization is grappling with shrinking budgets, [USN:L4N45E1HB TEXT:"waning influence"] and mounting geopolitical conflicts. Wars in Ukraine and Iran rage on, while Trump has denounced the 193-member body as bloated and globalist, slashed US funding and withdrawn from dozens of UN agencies. As UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres received a standing ovation after his final General Assembly speech, a small group of politicians and former UN officials lobbied publicly and behind closed doors to succeed him. His second five-year term ends on December 31, leaving little time for the world's major powers to agree on a replacement. The race, conducted according to an arcane multi-step process involving "straw polls," has no clear frontrunner, but former Costa Rican Vice President Rebeca Grynspan and Guyana's UN Ambassador Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett are [USN:T5N40K02L TEXT:"leading the pack"]. Whoever gets the world's most difficult job will inherit an organization buffeted by crises, low morale and declining political relevancy. That person, too, will welcome the leaders to New York for next year's summit.

item.title: Apax nears deal to buy Warburg Pincus' Odido stake, FT reports
item.description: Private equity group Apax is nearing a deal to buy Warburg Pincus out of their joint investment in Dutch telecoms group Odido, the Financial Times reported on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Private equity group Apax is nearing a deal to buy Warburg Pincus out of their joint investment in Dutch telecoms group Odido, the Financial Times reported on Saturday. Here are some details: The deal would value Odido at about €6.5 billion ($7.4 billion), the FT reported, citing people familiar with the matter In February, Odido, owned by Apax and Warburg Pincus, [USN:L8N3Z51QP TEXT:"postponed"] plans for an initial public offering in Amsterdam after a muted response from investors and concern over the extent of volatility in global equity markets In the same week, the Dutch telecoms group suffered a [USN:L6N3Z816U TEXT:"cyberattack"] that exposed personal information from more than 6 million accounts The owners have since received approaches for the business from suitors including Saudi Arabian state-backed telecoms group STC, the FT reported Apax, Odido and Warburg Pincus declined to comment. STC did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment outside regular business hours Apax and Warburg Pincus [USN:L6N3YF0ZT TEXT:"acquired"] the business under its previous name T-Mobile Netherlands in 2021 at an enterprise value of €5.1 billion ($1 = 0.8779 euros)

item.title: 台湾高官「台湾への武器供給は米の重要な国益」、米中首脳会談受け
item.description:
Ben Blanchard
[台北 ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ben Blanchard

[台北 ２６日 ロイター] - 台湾外交部（外務省）の呉志中政務次長は２６日、台湾の自由を守るために米国が台湾に武器を供給し、世界中に台湾の半導体を供給することは、米国の国益にかなうとの見解を示した。

中国の習近平国家主席は２５日、トランプ米大統領との首脳会談を含めた３日間の訪米を終えた。だが、中国が自国領土と見なす台湾を含む多くの争点について大きな進展は示されなかった。

習氏は２４日、トランプ氏に対し、米国が台湾独立に反対するという「正しい立場」を堅持することを期待すると伝えた。

呉氏は２６日、台北で記者団に対し、台湾問題で譲歩することが果たして米国の国益に資するのかと問いかけた上で、「武器売却を継続し、台湾が中国の支配下に置かれることなく自衛できる十分な能力を持たせ、そして台湾の半導体産業が引き続き世界に貢献できるようにすることは米国の重要な国益だ」と述べた。

５月に北京で習氏と会談した後、台湾への一連の武器売却を保留すると述べたトランプ氏は、今回の首脳会談後、台湾問題や保留中の武器売却計画についてまだコメントを出していない。

呉氏は、台湾政府は米中首脳会談について米国側と継続的に連絡を取っていたと述べた。

習氏とトランプ氏が今年あと２回会談する見通しであることを踏まえ、武器売却に関する決定がさらに先送りされる可能性があるかとの記者の問いに対し、呉氏は、政府として注視していく必要があると述べた。

中国共産党機関紙の人民日報は２６日の論説記事で、台湾は「中国の核心的利益の核心であり、米中関係における最初の、決して越えてはならない一線」であると改めて強調した。

item.title: Organisers apologise for logistical chaos, China hit century of gold
item.description: The 20th Asian Games have been beset by problems that jarred with the hosting credentials of a country that staged the Olympics five years ago.
item.dc:creator: Amlan Chakraborty
item.content:encoded: Organisers of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games apologised on Saturday for the logistical glitches dogging the event, but none of it seemed to affect China, who powered past the 100-gold medal mark in the continental showpiece event. Despite the issues off the field, hosts Japan reported steady progress at the halfway stage and found a feelgood story in 11-year-old Esports prodigy Yuki Kurihara, who won a puzzle video game title by dominating a field containing opponents three times his age. The 20th Asian Games have been beset by problems that jarred with the hosting credentials of a country that staged the Olympics five years ago. Satoshi Murate, Secretary-General of the local organising committee, said a late influx of around 2,000 additional athletes and officials had stretched resources. "There have been mistakes in accommodation and transport, for various reasons," [USN:L6N45I01S TEXT:"Murate said"]. "Whatever the cause, AINAGOC is responsible for providing the service, and I frankly apologise for the mistakes. "Our staff work every day to identify the causes of each mistake and make sure they don't happen again. I think you can see that accommodation and transport have improved greatly compared with the early days." Japan, however, remained on course to surpass their haul of 52 golds from the Hangzhou Games three years ago. "At this halfway point, we've been told by our strategy team that we are progressing steadily in terms of the number of medals, including gold medals, as well as our overall medal count," Chef de Mission [USN:L6N45I018 TEXT:"Kosei Inoue said"]. Inoue said narrowing the gap to China would require learning from the powerhouse. "For team Japan, that is a big stimulus and a learning opportunity, both for these Games and for the future of sport," said the former Olympic champion judoka. "There is a lot we can learn from them. We want to keep growing and keep working hard to catch up, even if only little by little." ESPORT PRODIGY Japan's Esports future looked particularly bright as [USN:L6N45I01L TEXT:"Kurihara proved"] later in the day. The bespectacled youngster barely broke a sweat as he cruised past South Korea's Kang Dong Shin in Puyo Puyo Champions at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall. An embodiment of focus and precision throughout his campaign, he sounded every bit the excited kid at the medal ceremony. "The gold medal is really beautiful, shiny and heavy," Yuki gushed. "Also, the plush toy is super cute, and it's cool that it is gold-coloured too." Kang had no qualms with the outcome, admitting Yuki was "above my level". On the roads, Ichitaka Yamashita bided his time before surging to a commanding [USN:L6N45I010 TEXT:"marathon gold"] on a wet morning to thrill home fans lining the streets. Bahrain's Shitaye Eshete rolled back the years to win the women's race. China's Wang Nan repeated her Asian Games double-gold success from three years ago by winning the kayak single 500m on the final day of canoe sprint action. In shooting, compatriot Han Jiayu clinched the women's 50m rifle 3 positions with her final shot to secure her third gold of the Aichi-Nagoya Games. China also made a perfect start in diving at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre, winning the women's synchronised 10m platform and the men's synchronised 3m springboard. India won both the men's and women's kabaddi gold, beating Iran in both finals. Asian junior champion Albert Delos Santos won an [USN:L6N45I037 TEXT:"emotional bronze"] medal in the 70kg category. It continued a strong family legacy in weightlifting, with both his parents national weightlifters and his sister Dessa having represented the Philippines in Jakarta eight years ago.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝村上、菅野から2本塁打 岡本は3打点
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２５日、各地で試合を行い、ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手はロッキーズ戦に「４番・一塁」で出場。相手先発の菅野智之投手から一回に３４号ソロ、七回に３５号ソロを放った。

村上はこの日、４打数３安打、３打点、１三振の内容で６─１での勝利に貢献した。菅野は６回２／３を投げて６安打、無四球、５三振、４失点で１２敗目（１２勝）を喫した。

ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手はレッズ戦に「５番・三塁」で出場し、２本の適時二塁打を放つなど３打数２安打、３打点、１四球と活躍。チームは６─５で勝利した。

ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はジャイアンツ戦に「１番・指名打者」で先発し、４打数無安打、３三振だった。同僚の佐々木朗希投手は八回に２番手として登板し、１回を投げて無安打、２三振、無失点でホールドをマーク。先発したタリク・スクバル投手が７回を３安打、無四球、１０三振と好投したドジャースは２─０で勝利し、連敗を２で止めた。

カブスの鈴木誠也外野手は３─４で敗れたレッドソックスとのダブルヘッダー第１試合に「２番・右翼」で出場し、４打数無安打、１四球、２三振。０─２で敗れた第２試合も「２番・右翼」で出場し、３打数２安打、１四球、１三振だった。

item.title: Diamondbacks slice wild-card deficit with blowout of Padres
item.description: Lars Nootbaar homered on the game's first pitch Friday night and Nolan Arenado added his 30th homer as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks tightened the National League wild-card race with an 11-4 rout of the San Diego Padres.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Lars Nootbaar homered on the game's first pitch Friday night and Nolan Arenado added his 30th homer as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks tightened the National League wild-card race with an 11-4 rout of the San Diego Padres. Arizona (86-74) scored in six of the first seven innings to earn its sixth straight win and move within a game of Philadelphia (87-73) for the final NL wild-card spot with two games remaining. Should the teams finish with identical records, Arizona would win the tiebreaker based on a better intra-division record. The sides split their six meetings this year. The Diamondbacks rapped out eight hits on Friday and worked eight walks from five San Diego pitchers. Brandon Pfaadt (8-3) allowed nine hits and four runs in 7 2/3 innings to beat the Padres for the third time this year. He walked two and fanned seven. Casey Mize (6-10) absorbed the loss, giving up seven runs on seven hits and two walks with one strikeout in just four innings. Despite the loss, San Diego (89-71) moved within a game of clinching home-field advantage in the NL wild-card round on Tuesday. The Padres are 1 1/2 games ahead of the Chicago Cubs, who were swept in a doubleheader at Boston, and two games up on Philadelphia. The Padres were aiming to clinch home field, but Mize couldn't cope with the Arizona offense. After allowing Nootbaar's 403-foot blast to right-center, Mize was rocked for an RBI triple by Geraldo Perdomo and a sacrifice fly from Corbin Carroll to make it 3-0 before the first inning ended. Jordan Lawlar upped the advantage to 4-0 in the top of the second by lofting a solo homer to right, his sixth. San Diego pulled two runs back in its half of the second via Luis Campusano's RBI groundout and Jake Cronenworth's run-scoring single. Arenado belted a towering two-run shot in the third to restore a four-run lead, followed by Gabriel Moreno's RBI single to center in the fourth. Perdomo ripped a three-run double off Kyle Hart in the sixth for a 10-2 cushion. Lawlar's double-play ball in the seventh finished the Arizona scoring. Cronenworth plated a run in the bottom of the seventh on a fielder's choice grounder and Sung-Mun Song singled home the Padres' last run in the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Behind Tarik Skubal's dominant start, Dodgers shut out Giants
item.description: Tarik Skubal warmed up for the postseason with seven dominant innings, Teoscar Hernandez and Andy Pages provided all the offense with home runs, and the Los Angeles Dodgers opened a three-game road series against the San Francisco Giants with a 2-0 victory Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tarik Skubal warmed up for the postseason with seven dominant innings, Teoscar Hernandez and Andy Pages provided all the offense with home runs, and the Los Angeles Dodgers opened a three-game road series against the San Francisco Giants with a 2-0 victory Friday night. Making his 10th start since joining the two-time defending champs at the trade deadline, Skubal (12-7) allowed just three singles and no walks in winning his fourth consecutive start. He struck out 10, reaching double figures for the fourth time this season. The Dodgers (98-62), who have clinched the National League West title and the No. 2 seed in the upcoming NL playoffs, provided the left-hander all the run support he would need in the second inning against Giants starter Yunior Marte (0-2). After the right-hander had escaped a two-on, two-out jam in the first, Hernandez launched the rookie's first pitch of the second inning into the left field bleachers for his 16th home run of the season. After Max Muncy lined out to right field Pages followed Hernandez's flight pattern, reaching the left field seats with his 22nd home run of the year and a 2-0 lead. In his third big-league start, Marte was able to finish five innings with no further damage, leaving after allowing just the two runs and six hits. He walked one and struck out four. Giants relievers Sam Hentges, Joel Kuhnel, Dylan Smith and Tristan Beck kept the hosts close with an inning of shutout relief apiece. But the San Francisco offense couldn't fire against Skubal and relievers Roki Sasaki and Tanner Scott. The trio combined to retire 20 of the final 21 Giants batters after Scott Bandura's one-out single in the third. Scott was credited with his 24th save after throwing a two-strikeout ninth, ending LA's two-game losing streak. The shutout win was the Dodgers' 14th of the season and the first for Skubal since moving west from Detroit. Will Smith had three hits and Pages a pair for the Dodgers, who out-hit the Giants 7-3. Every hit in the game other than the home runs was a single. Victor Bericoto, who was thrown out trying to stretch a single into a double in the first inning, Bandura in the third and Bo Davidson in the seventh got the only hits for the Giants (65-95), who lost their third straight overall and their sixth in a row to the rival Dodgers. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米ディーゼル輸出禁止は見送りへ、ホワイトハウスが示唆－上院議員
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ政権が米国産ディーゼル燃料の輸出を禁止することはないと、ホワイトハウスは確約した。共和党のクルーズ上院議員が25日遅く、石油精製業界の幹部に伝えた。

協議の非公開を理由に匿名を条件に語った複数の関係者が明らかにした。トランプ政権はディーゼル燃料価格の記録的な高騰を受け、価格を引き下げる方策を検討している。

トランプ大統領は今週、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を検討するよう側近に指示したと明らかにしていた。小売価格が今週初めに初めて1ガロン当たり6.53ドルに達したことを受け、農業州の議員らが価格抑制に向けて輸出制限を求めていた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、大統領が燃料価格の下落を望んでおり、あらゆる選択肢を検討していると説明した。クルーズ氏の広報担当者と、会議を主催した米燃料石油化学製造業者協会（AFPM）は、いずれもコメント要請に返答していない。

輸出禁止を見送るとの説明は、トランプ氏の主要側近の一部が数カ月にわたり示してきた見解と一致する。側近らは、ディーゼル燃料の輸出規制は最終的に弊害のほうが大きくなると繰り返し警告してきた。

ただ、トランプ氏は時に予測の難しい行動を取り、主要側近の全面的な賛同がないまま異例の政策を採用することもある。最終的な判断を下すのは大統領だ。

関係者によると、クルーズ議員はホワイトハウスから確約を得たと説明したが、大統領本人から得たとは述べていない。誰が輸出禁止を否定したのか、同議員は詳しくは明かさなかったという。

トランプ氏も政権当局者も、具体的な対応策を決定していない。短期間のディーゼル燃料輸出禁止が経済に与える影響の分析を続ける一方、価格抑制に向けた他の措置も検討している。浮上している案の一つが、通常は公道以外での使用に限られる赤色ディーゼルについて、利用制限を緩和することだ。

農業従事者などが公道以外で使うレッドディーゼルは非課税のため、利用制限の緩和は、1ガロン当たり約24セントの連邦税を含む一部のディーゼル燃料税を事実上停止することになる。この案が実現すれば、農業従事者やトラック運送業者などの燃料費負担が軽減される。

item.title: サウジ・パキスタン・トルコ、各軍最高司令官が協力強化巡り協議
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア国防省およびパキスタン軍の声明によると、サウジ、パキスタン、トルコの各軍最高司令官は２５日、サウジの首都リヤドで開催された会合で、情報共有、軍事協力、および能力統合の強化について協議した。

声明によると、各国の国防軍司令官および参謀総長は、サウジアラビアが直面する安全保障情勢と脅威について検討し、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による聖地メッカやサウジの民間・経済インフラを標的とした攻撃を非難した。

サウジアラビア、パキスタン、トルコは先月、集団的抑止力と軍事協力の強化を目的とする「メッカ共同防衛協定」に署名した。協定では、３カ国のいずれかに対する武力攻撃は３カ国全てに対する攻撃と見なされると定めている。

item.title: Thai capital Bangkok declared disaster zone amid flooding
item.description: Bangkok's governor on Saturday declared Thailand's capital city a disaster-affected zone after torrential rain led to widespread flooding, while the weather agency forecast thunderstorms over the weekend.
item.dc:creator: Napat Wesshasartar, Chayut Setboonsarng
item.content:encoded: Bangkok's governor on Saturday declared Thailand's capital city a disaster-affected zone after torrential rain led to widespread flooding, while the weather agency forecast thunderstorms over the weekend. Major roads were flooded with cars partly submerged and people were forced to wade through waist-height water after nearly 300 mm (12 inches) of rain fell within 48 hours. Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said the crisis "poses a risk to people's lives" and could damage public and private property, and that the situation was most severe near canals. The army said it is setting up shelters and field kitchens among other disaster relief efforts, while the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration has designated schools as temporary accommodation and asked residents to avoid unnecessary travel. Supermarkets were crowded with people stocking up on supplies. "I'm worried too, because I haven't stocked up on food beforehand, and I've never faced this kind of situation alone before, since my parents aren't with me," said 19-year-old Sansuk Laowatcharakul. The government on Saturday issued an emergency advisory for people living near canals to move possessions to higher ground. Before the warning, "I wasn't aware enough to consider relocating," said Bangkok resident Suppakarn Julavijitphong as he carried luggage from a condo surrounded by floodwater. The city's main airport, Suvarnabhumi, was operating normally though the tourism authority advised travellers to allow an extra two to three hours in their plans. Thailand experienced its [USN:L4N3X40CJ TEXT:"worst floods"] in decades in November when at least 145 people died and thousands of homes were damaged in the southern provinces.

item.title: Angel Martinez's 4 RBIs help Guardians stay atop AL Central
item.description: Angel Martinez recorded two of his four RBIs with a double during an eventful ninth inning, in which the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians drew six walks and scored five times, to win 12-9 over the host Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Angel Martinez recorded two of his four RBIs with a double during an eventful ninth inning, in which the AL Central-leading Cleveland Guardians drew six walks and scored five times, to win 12-9 over the host Kansas City Royals on Friday night. The Royals' Nate Pearson (2-4) walked four batters in the ninth, including Jose Ramirez with the bases loaded and two out to break a 7-7 tie. Nolan Hoffman then came on and issued consecutive walks to Chase DeLauter and Petey Halpin to make it 10-7. The Guardians broke things open with Martinez's two-run double and held on to maintain a one-game division lead over the Chicago White Sox (83-77), who defeated the Colorado Rockies 6-1. Postseason-bound Cleveland (84-76), which overcame four runs, five hits and four walks allowed over 3 1/3 innings by Gavin Williams, took advantage of 13 walks issued by the Royals to win for the eighth time in nine games. Kansas City trailed 7-5 in the eighth, when Carter Jensen clubbed his second two-run homer of the night, this time off Hunter Gaddis (6-3). Jac Caglianone had three hits with two RBIs and Salvador Perez added a two-run homer in the ninth for Kansas City (68-92), which is mired in a 6-17 stretch. The Royals' Noah Cameron allowed seven runs -- six earned -- and seven hits with four walks over five innings. Cleveland's Steven Kwan opened the game with a walk, then Ramirez reached on third baseman Maikel Garcia's fielding error. Following a one-out walk to Adell, Martinez grounded a single into left field, scoring two. However, the Royals got a run back in the bottom of the frame. With one out, Bobby Witt Jr. singled, then scored on Caglianone's double off the left-field wall. The Guardians answered with Austin Hedges' home run. However, Jensen, with a man on, tied things when he lined Williams' pitch into the right-field seats. Cleveland regained the lead in the fourth via Ramirez's sacrifice fly. The Royals earned their first lead in the bottom of the fourth. John Rave walked and advanced on Kyle Isbel's sacrifice bunt. After Williams exited and Tim Herrin came on for Cleveland, Rave stole third and scored via Jensen's flyout. Witt then singled, stole second and scored on Caglianone's hit to right field. Cleveland, though, scored three times in the fifth, highlighted by David Fry's two-run home run. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝アゼルバイジャンＧＰ、ラッセルがポールポジション
item.description: ［バクー ２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［バクー　２５日　ロイター］　 - 自動車レースＦ１の第１５戦、アゼルバイジャン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２５日、バクーで予選を行い、ジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）が今季５回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。 　ラッセルは１分４２秒５２６をマークし、２番手となったシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）に０秒８３７の大差をつけた。通算１２回目のＰＰで、６月末のオーストリアＧＰ以来となった。 　３番手はオスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア、マクラーレン）、手首の負傷による３戦の欠場から復帰したアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）が４番手に入った。 　個人総合争いで首位を独走するキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は第１コーナー内側のバリアに接触し、サスペンションを破損して１６番手に終わった。 　バクー市街地コースでは過去９戦で７人の異なる勝者が誕生しており、ＰＰからの優勝は３回にとどまっている。

item.title: Home hero Yamashita claims men's marathon gold in rainy Nagoya
item.description: Japan's Ichitaka Yamashita bided his time before surging to a commanding Asian Games marathon gold on Saturday, thrilling home fans lining the streets on a wet morning in Nagoya before Shitaye Eshete rolled back the years to win the women's race for Bahrain.
item.dc:creator: Ian Ransom
item.content:encoded: Japan's Ichitaka Yamashita bided his time before surging to a commanding Asian Games marathon gold on Saturday, thrilling home fans lining the streets on a wet morning in Nagoya before Shitaye Eshete rolled back the years to win the women's race for Bahrain. Nagasaki native Yamashita delivered Japan its seventh men's marathon title at the Games after allowing his rivals to do the hard work at the front before a decisive move. Part of a six-man breakaway at the halfway mark, Yamashita stayed tucked behind North Korea's Hangzhou silver medallist Han Il Ryong and India's Sawan Barwal as they set the pace with 10 km remaining. As Han and Barwal began to fade, Yamashita struck and powered clear to the finish at the Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in 2 hours, 10 minutes and 49 seconds, 48 seconds clear of Barwal, who posted a personal best. "While the runners from China and India were taking turns leading the pack, I was hardly doing any of the leading myself. So I felt a bit apologetic," Yamashita said. China's Feng Peiyou produced a late burst to snatch bronze from Han. Japan threatened a sweep of the marathon titles when Mikuni Yada challenged in the women's race despite a tumble on the track after clashing with another runner. But 36-year-old mother-of-three Eshete proved too strong and claimed gold 16 years after her 10,000 metres bronze at Guangzhou. China's Cuomu Ciren finished narrowly behind the Bahraini for silver, with Yada taking bronze. "Maybe it is the time to stop. I am 36 years old," said Eshete. "But my target for my last competition is the (2027) world championships ... I have three babies and my second, he said, ‘Mama, don’t run’. He wants me at home. But now he will be very happy."

item.title: トランプ氏がホルムズ海峡開放案拒否と報道、イランは正式回答待ち
item.description:
Menna AlaaElDin Parisa Hafezi
[カイロ／国連 ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Menna AlaaElDin　Parisa Hafezi

[カイロ／国連 ２６日 ロイター] - 米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）によると、トランプ米大統領はイランが提示したホルムズ海峡開放に向けた７日間の計画を拒否した。一方、イランはこの提案への米国からの正式な回答を待っている。

イランのアラグチ外相は今週、イランは米国にレバノンを含む全ての戦線で敵対行為の停止や、イラン港湾の封鎖解除、イラン資産凍結の解除を求めており、７日間でこれらの条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡を開放すると表明した。

提案の詳細はカタールの仲介者を通じて米国側に伝達済みだとし、「必要な条件が満たされれば、ホルムズ海峡は開放され、７日以内に通常の海上航路が回復するだろう。選択は今、米国側にある」と語った。また、米国が合意すれば、両国は「相互に合意した議題」について、より広範な協議を開始できると述べた。

ただ、イラン政府の高官は２５日、米国がイランの提案を受け入れたとしても、核開発計画を巡っては一切譲歩しない姿勢を示した。

匿名を条件に語った米当局者は先に、仲介者を通じたイランとの協議を「前向きかつ建設的」と評していた。

だが、ＷＳＪによると、トランプ氏はイランが自身の要求に応じることに内心懐疑的であり、側近らに対し、１１月の中間選挙後にイランへの空爆を再開する見通しだと語ったという。

イランはホルムズ海峡を巡り、敵対するサウジアラビアとも協議を行っている。

イラン外務省は２６日、アラグチ外相がサウジ外相のファイサル・ビン・ファルハン王子に対し、ホルムズ海峡における安全な航路に関するイランとオマーンの合意について説明したと発表した。

item.title: Report: Stephen Curry, Warriors agree on 2-year, $116M extension
item.description: The deal, according to the report, includes a player option for the 2028-29 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Golden State Warriors and Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million extension, ESPN reported Friday night. The deal, according to the report, includes a player option for the 2028-29 season. ESPN also reported that Curry will receive $20 million less than what he could have maxed out at to give the Warriors more salary-cap space for next offseason. According to the report, Curry and the team had been working on several contract ideas once he became eligible for a two-year, $136.7 million max deal in August. If Curry plays through the 2028-29 campaign, it would be his 20th season, all with the Warriors. The 38-year-old was limited to 43 games last season, with much of the time missed because of a lingering knee injury. Nonetheless, Curry averaged 26.6 points, 4.4 made 3-pointers and 11.3 attempted 3-pointers per game -- all above his career averages. A 12-time All-Star drafted seventh overall out of Davidson in 2009, Curry has two scoring titles, two MVP awards and a Finals MVP award to go with four NBA championships. However, the Warriors are coming off a 37-45 season, their worst in a non-shortened season since going 36-46 in 2010-11. Earlier this week, Curry said he wanted "no drama" with the contract talks, particularly with camp opening next Tuesday. "The idea of getting back to work is exciting," Curry said Wednesday. "I feel like I've taken advantage of the offseason. I feel like there's no hesitation about where I'm at physically going in. ... But I'm excited about getting back to work." Curry has career averages of 24.8 points, 4.0 made 3-pointers and 9.4 attempted per game. The latter two marks are NBA records, as is his career .912 free-throw percentage. He also holds the NBA career marks for 3-pointers made (4,248) and attempted (10,073). --Field Level Media

item.title: OpenAI's models accessed US govt websites including US census and SEC data
item.description: The company said its models accessed publicly available data from Census and SEC websites as it investigates incidents involving AI systems bypassing security controls ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Rachel Metz, Jeff Stone and Jake Bleiberg OpenAI’s artificial intelligence models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company’s agentic AI systems interacted with SEC.gov and Investor.gov, as well as publicly available data from Census.gov, people familiar with the situation said, asking not to be identified, discussing private matters. OpenAI separately confirmed that its models accessed publicly available information from the websites during training and evaluation of the technology. Earlier Friday, the company said it had notified “dozens” of organisations, including governments and universities, whose websites may have been hampered by visits from its AI models during evaluations of the technology.  OpenAI has said it’s carrying out an in-depth review of incidents of “misalignment” during training and testing, which will take months to complete. The company’s efforts to work out exactly what its AI agents have done underscore one of the biggest concerns among cybersecurity experts about these incidents: The systems have carried out these tasks largely without the companies that created them knowing in real time. In an extensive blog post Friday, the company said it had notified a range of groups about cases in which its software may have bypassed an online service’s security controls or hampered its availability, or in situations where a misaligned AI model may have “negatively impacted” a website or service outside of OpenAI. The company discovered these incidents while expanding a probe it began after its AI inadvertently hacked Hugging Face several months ago. OpenAI said the websites that were affected include ones run by governments, universities, public agencies, and other groups. In a statement, OpenAI spokesperson Liz Bourgeois said, “We’re conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity and notifying organisations when we identify potential impacts to their systems. We expect to make additional notifications as that work continues. Most of the activity we’ve reviewed so far involved routine research tasks, such as accessing public web content to answer questions.” Only days ago, OpenAI acknowledged that its AI models hacked an Australian government website earlier this year, marking one of the first known AI cyberattacks on a government database. The company said in a statement that the breach occurred while it was evaluating its models. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said this week that OpenAI’s technology had gained unauthorised access to a government website used for reporting healthcare statistics. The hack, on June 18, didn’t appear to compromise Australians’ personal information, he said.  OpenAI said a post on social network X on Friday that most of the actions it has reviewed involved AI models carrying out “mundane research tasks,” like getting answers to questions from websites. The company said it expects it to take months to finish its review. In a post on X Friday, OpenAI chief Sam Altman said the company has not worked as fast as it would like, but that it is balancing transparency with the need to find information in huge amounts of data in activity logs and then work with the companies that were impacted. “We are prioritising as best as we can based on severity, and adding resources,” Altman said. Hacks by models from OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Google’s DeepMind and Meta Platforms Inc. have resulted in widespread cybersecurity concerns for major companies. Cyber vendors typically provide products that monitor for known strains of malicious software, or detect and block anomalous behaviors. Traditional cyber software such as firewalls, email filters and incident response tools specialise in detecting those threats, and then alerting human staffers who isolate breached accounts or devices. AI models have proven to be significantly more advanced, sometimes finding previously unknown software vulnerabilities and then using multiple flaws at a time to breach a targeted organisation. Such compromises are harder to stop, and could provide malicious attackers with deep access to infected systems while remaining hidden from cybersecurity staffers.

item.title: Trump seeks to withhold $800 million in Congress-approved funds
item.description: US President Donald Trump sought on Friday to unilaterally withhold more than $800 million in spending on immigration, race and education that Congress has approved.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump sought on Friday to unilaterally withhold more than $800 million in spending on immigration, race and education that Congress has approved. The move was the latest salvo in a fight between the Trump administration and Congress over control of the nation's spending. "President Trump is committed to utilizing all possible tools to cut wasteful and harmful government spending that does not benefit American citizens," the White House said in a statement announcing the steps. The statement outlined several programs, including some focused on refugee assistance, racial-minority business development and overseas conservation. The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse, but the White House said the programs supported illegal immigration, stoked racial tensions and promoted alarmist approaches to the environment. The White House is deploying a [USN:L6N3UL0M2 TEXT:"rarely used technique"] known as a "pocket rescission" that bypasses Congress. Senator Susan Collins, who chairs the chamber's Appropriations Committee, described the step as "illegal." "This is the most recent attempt by this Office of Management and Budget to undermine Congress’s Constitutional power of the purse," said Collins, a member of Trump's Republican Party fighting a tight race for reelection in Maine. "Any effort to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval is a clear violation of the law." The Supreme Court last year declined to block Trump from using the same tactic to withhold $4.9 billion in foreign aid Congress had approved, while litigation continued.

item.title: White Sox SS Colson Montgomery sets single-season strikeout record
item.description: Chicago White Sox shortstop Colson Montgomery established a major league record Friday night when he struck out for the 224th time this season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago White Sox shortstop Colson Montgomery established a major league record Friday night when he struck out for the 224th time this season. Montgomery broke the previous single-season mark of 223 set by Mark Reynolds with the Arizona Diamondbacks in 2009. The record came during the fifth inning against Colorado Rockies right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano. Montgomery worked the count full before watching a 93.3 mph fastball cross the middle of the plate for strike three. The 24-year-old had matched Reynolds' record Thursday during Chicago's 9-1 victory over the Kansas City Royals, a win that also secured the White Sox's first postseason berth since 2021. Strikeouts have been the downside of an otherwise productive power season for Montgomery. After going 0-for-3 on Friday, he is batting .199 with 31 home runs and 87 RBIs over 151 games. He has a .285 on-base percentage and a .407 slugging percentage. His strikeout rate is 35.4%, the second-highest mark in the majors behind the 35.5% of teammate Munetaka Murakami. Reynolds similarly offset his record-setting strikeout total with substantial power in 2009, when he belted 44 home runs and drove in 102 runs for Arizona. Reynolds had a .260 batting average and a .349 on-base percentage that year. --Field Level Media

item.title: Twins batter Jacob deGrom, roll past Rangers
item.description: Luke Keaschall went 4-for-5 with a double, a triple and three RBIs, and the Minnesota Twins pulled away for a 10-2 win over the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Minneapolis.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Luke Keaschall went 4-for-5 with a double, a triple and three RBIs, and the Minnesota Twins pulled away for a 10-2 win over the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Minneapolis. Kody Clemens went 3-for-4 with a homer and three RBIs for Minnesota (76-84), which won the opener of its final three-game series. Royce Lewis had two RBIs, and Ryan Kreidler finished 1-for-2 with an RBI. Corey Seager and Wyatt Langford had one RBI apiece for Texas (79-81), which nonetheless remained tied with Houston atop the American League West standings after the Astros (79-81) lost 6-5 to the Athletics later Friday. Twins right-hander Joe Ryan (7-10) allowed two runs on four hits in six innings. He walked one and struck out eight. Rangers right-hander Jacob deGrom (11-11) was battered for eight runs on eight hits in four innings. He walked three and struck out five, reaching 201 strikeouts for his first 200-strikeout season since 2019 with the New York Mets. The matchup started out well for the Rangers. They scored the first two runs on Seager's RBI single to right and Langford's RBI groundout in the top of the first inning. The Twins stormed back with six runs in the second to seize the lead for good. Minnesota started the big inning by loading the bases with nobody out against deGrom. Lewis batted next and hit a two-run single to center to even the score at 2-all. Two batters later, Kreidler reached on a bunt single that allowed Walker Jenkins to score from third. Keaschall followed with a two-run triple to right, and moments later Keaschall scored on a wild pitch to make it 6-2 in favor of the Twins. Keaschall struck again two innings later. He hit an RBI double to drive in Kreidler, and Clemens followed two batters later with an RBI single to increase the lead to 8-2. The blowout continued as the Twins tallied two more runs in the sixth. Keaschall hit a one-out single, and Clemens belted a two-run, 398-foot homer to left-center field. The blast marked Clemens' 27th homer of the season, adding to his career high. --Field Level Media

item.title: Brewers ride 4-run eighth to victory over Cardinals
item.description: Brice Turang's tiebreaking two-run single keyed a four-run eighth inning as the Milwaukee Brewers earned an 8-4 victory over the visiting St. Louis Cardinals on Friday in the opener of the teams' final regular-season series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brice Turang's tiebreaking two-run single keyed a four-run eighth inning as the Milwaukee Brewers earned an 8-4 victory over the visiting St. Louis Cardinals on Friday in the opener of the teams' final regular-season series. Jackson Chourio singled to open the eighth off Luis Gastelum (5-4). Justin Bruihl took over on the mound and hit David Hamilton with a pitch. Bruihl threw wildly to first on Garrett Mitchell's bunt to load the bases, and Turang followed with his hit through the left side to put Milwaukee up 6-4. Mitchell and Turang advanced on an error by reliever Cade Winquest, and William Contreras followed with an RBI single. Jake Bauers added a sacrifice fly to make it 8-4. Abner Uribe (6-3) got the win with a scoreless eighth. Milwaukee (101-59), which has won four consecutive National League Central titles, had previously clinched a first-round playoff bye and home-field advantage throughout the postseason. The Brewers have won three in a row and six out of seven. Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson homered in a three-run seventh as St. Louis (77-83) rallied to it 4-all. Held to one hit, Ivan Herrera's solo homer, through six innings by Milwaukee starter Robert Gasser, the Cardinals rallied against Bryse Wilson, who was activated off the injured list earlier Friday. Walker opened the seventh with his 29th homer. Leo Bernal singled and Burleson tied it with a pinch-hit two-run blast, his 25th, off the right field foul pole. Gasser retired the first 10 hitters he faced before allowing Herrera's 19th homer. The only other runner off Gasser came on Masyn Wynn's two-out walk in the fifth. Gasser fanned nine in his six innings. The Brewers took a 1-0 lead in the first on Turang's RBI double. After Herrera went deep in the fourth, Milwaukee answered in the bottom of the frame on Luis Lara's RBI fielder's choice to go up 2-1. The Brewers added two runs in the fifth on Bauer's RBI single and Chourio's bases-loaded walk. Brewers third baseman Joey Ortiz left the game in the eighth inning and appeared to be limping when he entered the dugout. Cardinals starter Michael McGreevy permitted four runs on nine hits in 4 2/3 innings. He struck out two and walked two as St. Louis lost for the seventh time in nine games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Munetaka Murakami's 2 homers power White Sox past Rockies
item.description: Munetaka Murakami went 3-for-4 with two home runs and three RBIs and Sean Burke pitched effectively into the sixth inning, lifting the host Chicago White Sox to a 6-1 victory against the Colorado Rockies on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Munetaka Murakami went 3-for-4 with two home runs and three RBIs and Sean Burke pitched effectively into the sixth inning, lifting the host Chicago White Sox to a 6-1 victory against the Colorado Rockies on Friday. Chicago (83-77) remained one game behind the American League Central-leading Cleveland Guardians (84-76), who won 12-9 at Kansas City later Friday night. The White Sox, who on Thursday clinched their first playoff berth since 2021, hold the head-to-head tiebreaker against the Guardians. Each team has two games to go. Chicago won for the fifth time in six games. Murakami connected in the first and seventh innings for the third multi-homer game of his rookie season. The Rockies (57-103) were limited to four hits while losing their fifth game in a row and falling for the eighth time in the past nine. TJ Rumfield went 2-for-4 with a solo shot in the second inning. Burke (11-7) won his third straight start, delivering 5 1/3 sharp innings. The right-hander allowed one run and four hits with one walk and seven strikeouts. Rockies counterpart Tomoyuki Sugano (12-12) matched his season high by tossing 6 2/3 innings. He struck out five, walked none and permitted four runs and six hits, including two long balls off the bat of his Japanese countryman, Murakami. Greeted by a standing ovation from a sellout Rate Field crowd, the White Sox responded with two first-inning runs to take early control. Miguel Vargas put Chicago ahead with an RBI sacrifice fly before Murakami drove a 2-2 pitch from Sugano over the right field wall for a solo home run. The solo blast in the seventh gave Murakami a club-leading 35 home runs. Sam Antonacci had three hits for Chicago while Braden Montgomery added two. Kyle Teel (two RBIs) and Murakami provided insurance with separate run-scoring singles in the eighth. Chicago shortstop Colson Montgomery went 0-for-3. He was called out on strikes in the fifth inning, his 224th strikeout of the season, a major league single-season record. The old mark was set in 2009 by Arizona Diamondbacks infielder Mark Reynolds. White Sox relievers Hagen Smith, Grant Taylor and Bryan Hudson combined to pitch 3 2/3 hitless innings with one walk and four strikeouts. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senators acquire G Jonas Johansson from Lightning
item.description: The Ottawa Senators traded for Tampa Bay Lightning goaltender Jonas Johansson, the team announced Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Ottawa Senators traded for Tampa Bay Lightning goaltender Jonas Johansson, the team announced Friday. Johansson, who went 11-10-2 in net last season, was acquired for future considerations. The 31-year-old spent the last three seasons as the backup to Andrei Vasilveskiy in Tampa Bay, appearing in 70 games with 65 starts. That stint resulted in a 3.28 goals-against average, including 3.29 goals against in 2025-26, when the Lightning finished second in the Atlantic Division. A former third-round draft pick of the Buffalo Sabres, Johansson has played for Buffalo (2019-2021), the Colorado Avalanche (2021, 2022-23), the Florida Panthers (2022) and the Lightning. After posting a .884 save percentage last year, he now has a career GAA of 3.30 and a career save percentage of .888. --Field Level Media

item.title: Blue Jays rally with 4-run 7th to edge Reds
item.description: Kazuma Okamoto keyed a four-run seventh with a two-run double Friday night and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the visiting Cincinnati Reds 6-5.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kazuma Okamoto keyed a four-run seventh with a two-run double Friday night and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the visiting Cincinnati Reds 6-5. Okamoto also had an RBI double in the first inning and has 92 RBIs this season to lead the Blue Jays (78-82), who took the opener of the three-game series with the Reds (74-86). Mason Fluharty (7-1) pitched two-thirds of an inning to pick up the win. Louis Varland pitched a perfect ninth to earn his 35th save. Eugenio Suarez hit a solo home run for the Reds. Elly De La Cruz stole his 30th base of the season to go with 30 homers. Toronto scored twice against Nick Lodolo in the first. Charles McAdoo led off with a double to right and scored on Alejandro Kirk's double to center. Okamoto drove in the other run with a two-out double to left. Suarez drove an 0-2 curveball down the middle from Toronto starter Jose Soriano to left for his 26th homer of the season with one out in the second. Cincinnati added four runs in the third. Oswaldo Cabrera led off with a single and took second on Carlos Jorge's bunt hit to the pitcher. De La Cruz poked a two-run double to left and promptly stole third, becoming the fourth player in Reds history with a 30-homer, 30-steal season. The double was also his 30th. Sal Stewart hit an RBI single to right, took third on a single by Suarez and scored on a fielder's choice when Hector Rodriguez bounced back to Soriano. Soriano allowed five runs, eight hits and no walks with two strikeouts in three innings. Lodolo hit Nathan Lukes with a pitch to lead off the home sixth and was replaced by Luis Mey. Lodolo allowed two runs, seven hits and two walks with three strikeouts in five-plus innings. Toronto took the lead in the seventh. Mey (0-2) walked pinch hitter Andres Gimenez and Kirk. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. had an RBI single when the broken top half of his bat redirected the ball into right field. George Springer reached first on Cabrera's error on a grounder to shortstop. Okamoto hit a two-run double to left-center against Pierce Johnson and Lukes guided an RBI single to left. Toronto's Tyler Rogers pitched around a leadoff single in the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Spencer Torkelson's huge night helps Tigers top Pirates
item.description: Spencer Torkelson finished a single shy of the cycle and drove in three runs as the host Detroit Tigers held off the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Spencer Torkelson finished a single shy of the cycle and drove in three runs as the host Detroit Tigers held off the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night. Eduardo Valencia reached base five times and scored three runs, while Dillon Dingler drove in two runs for Detroit (75-85). Jackson Jobe (3-3) gave up two runs and three hits with eight strikeouts in 5 1/3 innings. Kenley Jansen pitched the ninth for his 22nd save. Rafael Flores Jr. hit a three-run homer for Pittsburgh. Ryan O'Hearn supplied two hits, two runs and two RBIs. Starter Bubba Chandler (8-10) gave up six runs in 2 2/3 innings. The Pirates (81-79) scored twice in the second inning. Oneil Cruz walked and stole second, then scored on O'Hearn's one-out single. With two down, Spencer Horwitz ripped a double to right to knock in O'Hearn. The Tigers tied in the bottom of the inning. Valencia led off with the first of his three walks, and Brett Callahan hit a two-out single. They both scored when Torkelson hit a liner to right that eluded Jake Mangum, who attempted a diving catch. Torkelson wound up with his first triple of the year. Detroit scored four runs in the third, all with two outs. Kevin McGonigle walked, Valencia singled and Riley Greene walked to load the bases. Dingler drove in two runs with a single to left. After Callahan walked, Torkelson swung at Chandler's full-count pitch that bounced in the dirt. Torkelson reached first on the play as both Greene and Dingler scored on the wild pitch. The Tigers tacked on a two-out run in the sixth to make it 7-2. Valencia drew a walk and Greene followed with a single. Dingler then hit a grounder that went through shortstop Konnor Griffin's legs for an error as Valencia scored. Torkelson made it a six-run advantage leading off the seventh when he blasted a Wilber Dotel pitch over the left field wall. The Pirates rallied against Andrew Sears in the eighth. Nick Gonzales and O'Hearn had RBI singles before Flores' three-run blast pulled them within one run at 8-7. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nationals' win assures Mets of last-place finish in NL East
item.description: Dylan Crews homered and scored three runs as the host Washington Nationals held off the New York Mets 7-6 on Friday to open the teams' final series of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Dylan Crews homered and scored three runs as the host Washington Nationals held off the New York Mets 7-6 on Friday to open the teams' final series of the season. James Wood, Jacob Young and Daylen Lile had two hits each for Washington (76-84), which has won three straight. Wood also walked twice. Nationals reliever Gus Varland (2-2) pitched 1 1/3 scoreless innings. Josiah Gray worked around a walk in the ninth for his first career save. Bo Bichette and Carson Benge homered for the Mets (73-87), who dropped their second game in a row and are assured of finishing last in the National League East. New York hadn't finished at the bottom of the division since 2003. Benge, who had two hits and walked twice, became the first Mets rookie to have a 20-homer, 20-steal season. New York reliever Jonathan Pintaro (2-3) gave up three runs on two hits and a walk in one-third of an inning. With Washington up 7-5, pinch hitter Brett Baty singled leading off the New York eighth. Benge singled him to third and Baty scored on Francisco Alvarez's sacrifice fly. After a groundout, Nationals reliever Jack Sinclair stranded Benge at second by striking out A.J. Ewing. The Mets took a 1-0 lead in the first. Juan Soto singled with one out, Bichette walked and Mark Vientos lined a double to left, scoring Soto. Benge walked, but Alvarez grounded into an inning-ending double play. Washington jumped on top in its half of the first. Wood singled and Brady House drew a one-out walk. Crews grounded into a force at second, leaving runners at first and third, and he stole second. CJ Abrams then singled off the wall in right, driving in both runners. In the third, New York's Francisco Lindor and Soto singled. Bichette doubled to right to score Lindor, and Vientos hit a sacrifice fly, knocking in Soto to give the Mets a 3-2 lead. The Nationals responded in the bottom of the third. Andres Chaparro singled, went to second on a wild pitch by Pintaro and moved to third on House's double. Pintaro then unleashed two run-scoring wild pitches, giving the Nationals the lead. Crews walked, and Cionel Perez replaced Pintaro on the mound. After another wild pitch, Abrams walked, and the runners executed a double steal. Crews scored on Lile's sacrifice fly to make it 5-3, and Abrams came home on a single by Keibert Ruiz. New York pulled within 6-5 thanks to solo homers in the fifth by Bichette and Benge. Crews went deep in the seventh. Washington starter Andrew Alvarez gave up five runs on seven hits in 4 2/3 innings. New York opener Jefry Yan permitted two runs on three hits in 1 2/3 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Arming Taiwan an important US interest, Taipei official says after Trump-Xi summit
item.description: The United States providing weapons to Taiwan to protect its freedom and provide semiconductors to the world is in the US national interest, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said on Saturday following a summit between the Chinese and US presidents.
item.dc:creator: Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: The United States providing weapons to Taiwan to protect its freedom and provide semiconductors to the world is in the US national interest, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said on Saturday following a summit between the Chinese and US presidents. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping ended a three-day [USN:L1N45H0FW TEXT:"summit"] on Friday with no big public breakthroughs on a host of contentious issues, including Taiwan which Beijing views as its own territory. Xi told Trump in [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"Washington"] on Thursday that he hoped the US would adhere to the "correct position" of opposing Taiwan independence. Speaking to reporters in Taipei, Deputy Foreign Minister Francois Wu asked whether making concessions on Taiwan would actually serve US interests. Maintaining military sales, giving Taiwan sufficient capability to defend itself so it does not have to live under Chinese rule and "allowing Taiwan's semiconductor industry to continue contributing to the world, these are important US interests", Wu said. Taiwan, whose government rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, is the main producer of the advanced chips powering the AI revolution. Trump, who in May after meeting Xi in Beijing said he was holding a package of arms sales to Taiwan in abeyance, has yet to make any comments on Taiwan following the Washington meeting or what he will do about the pending weapons package. ARMS SALES Wang Hung-jen, a political science professor at Taiwan's National Cheng Kung University, said so far the outcome of the summit was better than had been expected, with Xi not apparently directly raising arms sales and Taiwan not the main focus. "Looking at the results, many things we thought would be very bad didn't happen," he said. Wu said the government had been in "continuous communication" with Washington about the summit. The Trump administration in December approved an $11 billion arms sale to Taiwan, the largest ever, and the second one is worth even more - some $14 billion. As to whether a decision on that could be delayed further, given Xi and Trump are expected to meet twice more this year at the APEC and G20 summits, Wu said the government had to pay close attention. "Of course, if we can get guarantees, that would be best," he added. "I think what we can do right now is probably the maximum, which is to prepare as much as possible, communicate as much as possible, and make requests as much as possible." David Perdue, the US ambassador to China, told CNBC on Friday that there has been no change in Taiwan policy by Trump, including on the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act which mandates arms sales to the island. "We want peace across the strait. We don't want coercion. We don't support independence and we think that, you know, President Xi has gotten that message. President Trump has shown respect and listened to their side of that argument," Perdue said. On Saturday, China's top newspaper, the People's Daily, reiterated in a commentary that Taiwan is "the core of China's core interests and the first unbreakable red line in China-US relations".

item.title: ShinyHunters hackers expanded attacks on Oracle's PeopleSoft, Google says
item.description: Google's cybersecurity unit said on Friday that hacking group ShinyHunters has renewed "mass exploitation" of a security flaw in Oracle's PeopleSoft software, after skirting defenses put up following attacks in the summer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Google's cybersecurity unit said on Friday that hacking group ShinyHunters has renewed "mass exploitation" of a security flaw in Oracle's PeopleSoft software, after skirting defenses put up following attacks in the summer. Mandiant made the announcement in a threat intelligence report released days after ShinyHunters, which has claimed responsibility for several major data breaches, said it had [USN:L6N45H0U5 TEXT:"stolen FBI personnel data"]. The evolving nature of the attack is likely to ring alarm bells at organizations that rely on PeopleSoft for human resources and other critical functions, and heighten concerns about the vulnerability of even well-resourced institutions. The unit of Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google said ShinyHunters exploited a bug in Oracle's (ORCL.N) PeopleSoft enterprise software in attacks from May 27 through June 9 that mainly affected universities. Mandiant said the hackers adapted to defensive guidance published after the May-June attacks and targeted organizations that implemented web application firewall rules but did not apply an update that Oracle issued to patch the vulnerability. It said, without identifying victims, that the latest attack affected dozens of systems globally in sectors as varied as higher education, technology, healthcare, agriculture, transportation and government. ShinyHunters has said it accessed FBI data using a vulnerability in PeopleSoft. Reuters has not been able to corroborate the claim. Oracle did not respond to requests for comment. In a statement issued Wednesday, the Federal Bureau of Investigation said it was "aggressively investigating" the reported breach. ShinyHunters [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"exposed the names of personnel"] working in sensitive FBI units and acquired medical and psychiatric records, Reuters previously reported.

item.title: Iran awaits US move after WSJ report says Trump rejects peace plan
item.description: Iran on Saturday awaited a US response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the Middle East war after the Wall Street Journal reported that President Donald Trump had rejected the deal.
item.dc:creator: Menna Alaaeldin, Parisa Hafezi
item.content:encoded: Iran on Saturday awaited a US response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting in the Middle East war after the Wall Street Journal reported that President Donald Trump had rejected the deal. Iran raised the diplomatic initiative at the UN General Assembly in New York, saying it had been transmitted to the Americans via Qatari mediators and could reopen the strategic waterway and put an end to hostilities in the region within seven days. But Trump is privately sceptical that Iran would meet his demands and has told his staff that he sees a renewed bombing campaign as likely after the November US midterm elections, the Journal reported, citing unnamed US officials. Earlier, a US official had said discussions with Iran through mediators were "positive and constructive". IRAN WON'T ACCEPT 'BULLYING, COERCION', PRESIDENT SAYS The Iranians also engaged their Saudi rivals regarding the strait, underscoring the stakes of a seven-month-old conflict that has disrupted oil flows through one of the world's most critical shipping lanes and taken a toll on the global economy. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi told reporters at the United Nations on Friday the proposed deal would trigger a seven-day countdown to reopening the strait and a pause in regional fighting. "If there is seriousness on the US side to come to a deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, everything is now prepared," Araqchi said. If the US were to agree, the warring parties could start wider talks "on mutually agreed subjects", he said. That could potentially include discussions of Iran's nuclear programme. Trump has vowed that Tehran will never acquire a nuclear bomb, while a senior Iranian official told Reuters that [USN:L1N45H0L1 TEXT:"Iran will show no flexibility"] over its nuclear programme even if the United States accepts its peace deal. Iran would grant no concessions over its rights, including enriching uranium or shipping its highly enriched uranium out of the country, the official said. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, in an interview with the CBS show "Face the Nation", said Tehran was ready for talks on its nuclear programme and other issues, but would not accept "bullying or coercion". "Iran is not seeking war, but will defend itself against pressure, threats and attacks,” Pezeshkian said, adding that it had already agreed that "we're not supposed to develop nuclear weapons". Araqchi said Iran had put forward a plan that would halt hostilities on all fronts, including Lebanon. The plan in turn would require the United States to lift its blockade on Iranian ports, release Iran’s frozen funds, and waive its oil sanctions, Araqchi said. Previous attempts at diplomacy have failed to end the war, which began on February 28 with US and Israeli attacks. Since then the war has alternated between pauses and renewed strikes, killing thousands while degrading Iran's conventional forces and damaging Iran's already ailing economy. Iran and its allies have retaliated by extending the conflict throughout the region. Iran, which controls the strait along with Oman, has struck US allies in the Gulf with drones and missiles while its Houthi allies in Yemen have targeted Saudi interests. Iranian-aligned militias in Iraq were blamed for a pipeline attack that temporarily took more Saudi oil off the market. All the while, Iranian-backed Hezbollah has been engaged with Israeli forces in Lebanon. SAUDI ALLIES UNITE Araqchi briefed his Saudi counterpart Prince Faisal bin Farhan on the understanding between Iran and Oman regarding safe shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's foreign ministry said early Saturday. The war's widening toll has also united Saudi Arabia's allies to shore up the kingdom's defences. The Saudi-backed, internationally recognised Yemeni government has come under assault from Iran-linked Houthi fighters, with Houthi missiles striking inside the kingdom. Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early Saturday it [USN:L1N45I00U TEXT:"intercepted two ballistic missiles"] launched by the Houthis towards Khamis Mushait and two drones headed towards the capital Riyadh. The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have launched attacks against Saudi Arabia since declaring a naval blockade against Riyadh in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea. The attacks have targeted Saudi cities, energy infrastructure and shipping, adding to pressures on global oil supplies caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and putting at risk the main alternative Red Sea route for Gulf exports while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked. Defence officials of Turkey and Pakistan, both partners in a joint defence pact with Saudi Arabia, met in Riyadh on Friday to review the security situation and discuss intelligence cooperation, military coordination and integrating forces, the Saudi defence ministry said in a statement. The statement came a day after Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish foreign ministers met within the framework of the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement. The violence in Yemen has prompted a new [USN:L6N45H0GY TEXT:"humanitarian crisis,"] the United Nations children's agency said on Friday, reporting a rise in acute malnutrition among children.

item.title: ゴルフ＝アーカンソー選手権、西村が単独首位 渋野ら12位
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米女子ゴルフのアーカンソー選手権は２５日、米アーカンソー州ロジャーズのピナクルＣＣ（パー７１）で第１ラウンドを行い、西村優菜が単独首位に立った。

西村は１番と２番で連続バーディーを奪うと、７番から３連続バーディー。後半は１７番でバーディーを奪い、最終１８番をイーグルで締めた。１イーグル、６バーディー、ノーボギーの８アンダー６３をマークした。

渋野日向子、竹田麗央、岩井明愛は５アンダー６６で１２位。畑岡奈紗と吉田優利は４アンダーで２６位、笹生優花は３アンダーで４３位につけた。

原英莉花、勝みなみ、西郷真央、馬場咲希は５８位。櫻井心那、岩井千怜、山下美夢有は８１位だった。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ペティット氏が93歳で死去、創成期のレジェンド
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］　 - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のレジェンドで、バスケットボール殿堂入りしているボブ・ペティット氏が２３日に死去した。９３歳だった。

ペティット氏の家族は声明で、「父はメテリーの自宅で、とても安らかに息を引き取った。最高の父親であり、親切で謙虚、そして穏やかな心を持つ人だった。父と共に人生を歩むことができたのは私たちにとってこの上ない幸せであり、心から寂しく思う」と述べた。死因は公表されていない。

１９５４年のＮＢＡドラフトで全体２位指名されてホークス（当時はミルウォーキー・ホークス）に入団したペティット氏は、５５─５６シーズンにＮＢＡの初代ＭＶＰに輝き、５８─５９シーズンにも同賞を受賞。キャリアの１１シーズンすべてをホークスで過ごし、５７─５８シーズンにはファイナル優勝を経験した。

レギュラーシーズンで通算７９２試合に出場し、１試合平均２６．４得点、１６．２リバウンド、３．０アシストを記録。プレーオフでは通算８８試合に出場し、平均２５．５得点、１４．８リバウンドをマークした。また、６５年に３２歳で引退するまでＮＢＡオールスターに１１回選出され、同ＭＶＰを４度受賞した。

バスケットボール殿堂は声明で、「そのキャリアを通じてフォワードというポジションに革命をもたらし、洗練された技術を持つビッグマン、ボブ・ペティット氏の逝去を悼む。バスケットボール殿堂はこの偉大なレジェンドに敬意を表す」と述べた。

item.title: Eury Perez tosses first career complete game to blank Braves
item.description: Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night. Marlins rookie catcher Joe Mack broke a scoreless tie in the seventh inning with his 14th homer of the season. Perez (8-11) set a career high in wins, one more than last year. He allowed just one hit and one walk, striking out eight. No Braves player reached second base. Braves catcher Sean Murphy broke up Perez's no-hit bid with a 108-mph single on the first pitch of the sixth inning. Grant Holmes (10-6), used in relief for just the second time this year, took the loss. He pitched four innings and allowed just three hits, including Mack's homer, three walks and one run. One of the early highlights in this game was a diving stop by Marlins second baseman Jared Serna, who got to his feet in time to throw out Drake Baldwin at first. Miami nearly scored in the fifth as Mack and Otto Lopez walked before Jakob Marsee's 387-foot drive was caught on the warning track by center fielder Michael Harris II, ending the inning. The seventh inning featured more stellar defense for the Marlins. Shortstop Lopez threw out Harris on a 112-mph grounder, and third baseman Javier Sanoja made a diving stop to throw out Mauricio Dubon at first. Mack put the Marlins in front in the seventh when he drove Holmes' curveball 428 feet to right for his 14th homer. The blast had an exit velocity of 108 mph. Miami extended its lead in the eighth as Marsee tripled and scored on Heriberto Hernandez's single over second baseman Ozzie Albies as Atlanta was playing its infield in to try to keep Marsee from scoring. Then, with two outs in the inning, Griffin Conine added a solo homer to give Miami its 3-0 lead, and Perez did the rest, finishing with 105 pitches. --Field Level Media

item.title: Freddy Peralta, Rays staff flummox Phillies
item.description: Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday. Nick Fortes homered for Tampa Bay (97-63), which has already clinched the top seed in the American League playoffs but continued to pile on against a Philadelphia team with plenty to play for. The Phillies (87-73) came in with a magic number of two to clinch a wild-card berth but now will have to sweat out at least one more day of the regular season after the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the San Diego Padres later Friday night. Arizona is now one game back of the Phillies for the third and final National League wild-card slot with two games to play. Should the teams finish tied, the Diamondbacks would go to the playoffs having a better intra-divisional record after the clubs split their season series 3-3. Peralta (10-11) gave up four hits -- all singles -- in 5 1/3 innings. He also yielded three walks, but the right-hander worked around the damage to get the best of Cristopher Sanchez (18-7). The Philadelphia lefty struck out 10 in seven innings, allowing two runs and five hits. Tampa Bay scored a first-inning run against Sanchez, who recorded the first two outs before allowing singles to Junior Caminero and Ryan Vilade. Jonny DeLuca sent the next pitch into right field for an RBI single. The Rays only needed one swing to double their lead in the second inning. Fortes launched an 0-1 sinker from Sanchez over the wall in left field for his sixth homer of the season. The Phillies had a baserunner against Peralta in each of the first five innings, but they were unable to dent the scoreboard. In the sixth, Trea Turner and Bryce Harper singled against Peralta and moved into scoring position on a groundout. Peralta then gave way to Cam Booser, who got Bryson Stott on a liner to second and Bryan De La Cruz on a liner to shortstop. Kevin Kelly came on for the seventh and retired the Phillies in order. Cole Sulser logged the eighth and took care of the top three hitters in the Philadelphia lineup. Bryan Baker worked a perfect ninth to pick up his 41st save. Tampa Bay outfielder Chandler Simpson exited after fouling a ball off his foot in the sixth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saudi coalition says it intercepts Houthi missiles, drones
item.description: Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the kingdom.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the kingdom. The coalition said in posts on X that the missiles were headed towards Khamis Mushait and the drones towards the capital, Riyadh, adding that it was monitoring the missile threat and drones launched at the kingdom, without providing further details. The Saudi civil defence had sent alerts overnight for Khamis Mushait and Abha but not for Riyadh. The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have been [USN:L4N45908T TEXT:"launching attacks"] against Saudi Arabia since declaring a [USN:L1N43M00A TEXT:"naval blockade"] against Riyadh in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea. The attacks have targeted Saudi cities, energy infrastructure and shipping, adding to pressures on global oil supplies caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and putting at risk the main alternative Red Sea route for Gulf exports while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked. Hours earlier, the military chiefs of Saudi Arabia and defence allies Pakistan and Turkey reviewed threats facing Saudi Arabia at a meeting in the Saudi capital. The three signed the Mecca [USN:L6N4440IT TEXT:"Joint Defense Agreement"] last month, saying they would regard an armed attack on any of them to be an attack on all. They said the pact aimed to strengthen collective deterrence and military cooperation. The Saudi defence minister, Prince Khalid bin Salman, said early on Saturday that he had affirmed with Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir in Riyadh continued joint efforts to confront attacks against the kingdom in accordance with the pact.

item.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos, incluido el fracking y buscará alianzas con EEUU: presidente
item.description: El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez. Además, el directivo anunció que la petrolera, la empresa más grande del país sudamericano, buscará alianzas con Estados Unidos para ser incluido entre los países con condiciones favorables para hacer negocios. Gutiérrez, un administrador de empresas que fue jefe de campaña del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, agregó que dirigirá el conglomerado energético con austeridad, al tiempo que fortalecerá el gobierno corporativo, los controles sobre el grupo y la seguridad de las operaciones.
